│ The refusal message collapses four fault cases into two, so a supplied
│ setting gets told "none was supplied". How should the refusal get its words?
❯   Print the library's own     ✔    ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 1.detail (Recommended)           │ AMBIGUOUS, setting supplied but id absent:                    │
  2. Two more sentences from      │   REFUSING: the pinned control id=5 matches 0 of the          │
    you                           │   candidate controls on this device; a pin that does not      │
  3. Only fix "none was           │   name exactly one candidate resolves nothing.                │
    supplied"                     │   To fix it, re-pin from the list above, then run again.      │
                                  │                                                               │
                                  │ UNREADABLE, device answered, control has no level:            │
                                  │   REFUSING: pinned control id=9 is a switch, which carries    │
                                  │   no level to snapshot.                                       │
                                  │   To fix it, re-pin, then run again.                          │
